business: DrinksHarbour — Stream 1 e-commerce per ORDER (platform SUBSIDISES delivery at real Abuja drop cost)
note: All NGN before VAT. AOV ₦40,000 (estimate). Delivery NOT passed to the customer: platform absorbs the real per-drop bike-dispatch cost (~₦3,500, public Abuja rates) as a fixed per-order cost. This is deliberately the stress case against the old 3%-of-GMV subsidy assumption.

variable.label: Delivery drop cost (Abuja bike dispatch, real)
